content: असमर्थ {%a.%} .²1 Not able or competent; अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि <ls>Bg. 12. 10</ls>. .²2 Weak, feeble. .²3 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) Powerless to convey the intended meaning, a defect of a word; यत्तदर्थं पठ्यते न च तत्रास्य शक्तिः तदसमर्थत्वम् <ls>K. P. 7</ls>; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} in कुञ्जं हन्ति कृशोदरी; हन्, though read in root-books in the sense of ‘going’, is here powerless to convey that meaning.
